'''Questioner-9''' was a interrogation serum favored by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Used by local police, the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], and the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] alike, Questioner-9 could be injected or ingested for the use in interrogations.<ref name="EV" />
